		 Subject: Summit Ridge Advisors

Angela,
Bonnie,

I have attached an amended credit worksheet for the referenced portfolio company. This amended worksheet includes a Guaranty from its parent entity of $5MM, thus increasing the collateral threshold to $5MM, and amending other financial covenants.

Per the Deal Team Comment in Portfolio Ops, Bonnie received a call from the counterparty requesting a 'less complicated' documentation package.  In the comment, Bonnie suggested using an ISDA Schedule and Credit Support Annex, if this structure is acceptable from a Portfolio Ops standpoint, I am OK using the Industrial template from an Investor Relations standpoint.

Please draft this amended credit worksheet to reflect an amended ISDA Schedule.

Thank you,

Ryan
